blocks.text: Sports and Lifestyle Documentary
Namotu Island Resort.

Namotu Island is Fiji’s world class destination for water and sports experiences with easy access to Fiji’s premiere surf breaks. Beau in conjunction with Pepper Productions has produced many different videos promoting the island and services. Although an amazing island in a beautiful setting it is a difficult environment to shoot in due to dealing with the elements. Shooting from the water, in the water, land based and with drones the equipment gets abused.
Fiji Dentist Documentary.

The Fiji Dentist Documentary has been a massive production from start to finish. Our Pepper crew spent two weeks in Fiji capturing the group of American dentists as they gave up their time to help with the dental and medical needs in a remote part of Fiji. Follow their journey and discover how their whole operation runs.
Namotu Cobolt Promo.
Namotu Cobolt Promotional Video:
The Namotu Cobolt is the islands brand new Charter fishing boat.

The 320CC World Cat was brought over to Fiji in 2019 and for its release we flew our Photographer/videographer Beau to capture this beast in action. We were in charge of creating a short promo showing what the Cobalt is made of!
Namotu Fishing Adventures.
The Namotu fishing adventures follows the story of Ben Wilson from Namotu, Pro Surfer Adam Melling and Dyllon Schulz in their never-ending quest to find the ultimate fishing spots in Fiji.
Based out of Namotu Island, the trio spent 4 full days out on the boat hunting a huge variety of species.
Namotu Island Resort Photography.

Sunshine Coast Photography at its Finest
The Brief
The objective for Pepper Productions was clear:

One of the most recognisable natural landmarks on the Sunshine Coast is the Glass House Mountains, surrounded by expansive working pine forests that play a vital role in Queensland’s forestry industry. These forests are managed and maintained by HQ Plantations, with a strong focus on safety, sustainability, and operational excellence.

Pepper Productions partnered with HQ Plantations to develop a series of safety and awareness videos filmed on location within active forestry sites across the Sunshine Coast. The objective was to capture authentic interviews, real-world working environments, and cinematic visuals that support clear safety messaging—without disrupting live operations.

Our crew entered the sites fully equipped with high-visibility PPE and steel-cap boots, transporting camera and drone equipment deep into restricted logging areas. Filming in active forestry environments presents unique challenges, particularly around access limitations and heavy machinery in operation.

To safely navigate these constraints, we deployed specialised drone setups using longer 70mm and 150mm lenses. Flying low to the ground, these drones allowed us to replicate ground-level camera movement while maintaining safe distances from equipment and personnel. This approach delivered immersive visuals that place viewers inside the environment—without compromising site safety.

The finished safety campaign combines cinematic aerial footage, on-site interviews, and environmental visuals to communicate HQ Plantations’ commitment to safe forestry practices. The project resulted in a versatile library of photo and video assets designed for internal training, external communications, and long-term awareness campaigns.
Safety Campaign developed, shot, and edited by Pepper Productions.
Behind the Scenes
Blurring the Line Between Work and Play

As a Sunshine Coast video production company, we are always chasing projects that allow us to combine strong visual storytelling with unforgettable locations. Filming aboard the Cure 55 carbon catamaran delivered exactly that.

Our team spent several full days on the water capturing premium video content that reflected the craftsmanship, performance and lifestyle behind the Cure Marine brand. From early starts at Mooloolaba Beach through to long sails up the coastline toward Coolum, every moment was designed to showcase these luxury vessels in their natural environment.
Twin 55's

This project required a balance of creative storytelling and technical precision. Our Sunshine Coast videographers captured cinematic drone footage that showcased the scale and performance of the Cure 55 under sail, paired with lifestyle visuals that reflected the experience of being on board.

Filming along the Sunshine Coast coastline from Mooloolaba to Coolum allowed us to produce high end marine video content that feels both aspirational and authentic. With ideal sailing conditions across multiple shoot days, we were able to deliver smooth, dynamic visuals designed to support Cure Marine’s marketing and sales channels.
All The Little Details

Beyond the lifestyle visuals, we also produced a full walkthrough video with Dave, one of the owners of Cure Marine. This video was designed to give prospective buyers a complete understanding of the Cure 55 carbon catamaran, from design and layout through to the finer details that set it apart.
This style of content is a powerful tool for luxury and marine brands, allowing customers to experience the product before stepping on board.
